solar_panels.evidence: The central roof has blue-tinted dark panels with white edge lines. This looks like a tarp or shaded dark roofing, not a regular solar grid, so it is not counted.

detached_structure.evidence: The only other structure is a light-roofed building at the lower right. It sits at the tile edge and probably belongs to a neighboring lot. Nothing separate is clearly visible on the central lot.

signals.notes: The central house is heavily surrounded by dense mature trees and leaf litter. Its dark roof has a blue tint with white linear edges that may be a tarp or covering, so a field rep should check roof condition in person.
